w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
firstContext: Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
📺 SYSTEM: "📈 your showbiz fans +3 — the snore symphony (favor: 3)"
📺 SYSTEM: "🎨 COLOR: It did the thing! Should we be proud? I feel something. Is this pride? Log it."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/10/4), with 2 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 16 · Craft 13 · Talk 9 · Explore 25 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sari Wulandari ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,047 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Phase Shawl. Sometimes your shoulder isn't where the spear lands. The shawl knows. Don't ask how. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
